key.name: show-codex
key.description: Whether to show the Codex (ChatGPT) provider in the panel and menu.

key.name: show-claude
key.description: Whether to show the Claude Code provider in the panel and menu.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to fetch usage data, in seconds.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: Show the usage in the panel as text, as a small progress bar, or both.

key.name: percent-mode
key.description: Show percentages as used quota (Claude style) or remaining quota (Codex style).

key.name: panel-window
key.description: Which rate-limit window drives the panel value: the 5-hour window, the weekly window, or whichever is more used.

key.name: show-model-windows
key.description: Whether to show additional per-model usage windows (for example the weekly Fable or Opus quota) in the menu, in addition to the 5-hour and weekly windows.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the provider icons in the panel.

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL used for API requests, for example http://localhost:3128. Leave empty to use the system default.

key.name: codex-usage-url
key.description: Endpoint used to fetch Codex usage. Only change this for testing against a mock server.

key.name: codex-token-url
key.description: OAuth token endpoint used to refresh an expired Codex access token in memory. Only change this for testing.

key.name: claude-usage-url
key.description: Endpoint used to fetch Claude Code usage. Only change this for testing against a mock server.
